rationale: Fix-up diff (176 lines, 6 files) addresses all three prior findings cleanly. CR-001 wires trigger('temperature') via useEffect keyed on selectedModel in both duplicate forms — AssistantSetupSection took trigger as a new prop from AssistantForm; VirtualAssistantForm already had trigger from useForm. CR-002 adds a name-based fallback in getTemperatureMax when the store lookup misses, with two new unit tests covering the EditAssistant in-flight and getLLMModels-failure paths. CR-003 stubs mockAPI GET v1/llm_models with a GPT-4o fixture in the pre-existing 'out of range' integration test, decoupling it from test order. No new high-risk issues introduced by the fix-up: the mount-time trigger is a no-op for undefined temperature; the substring 'claude' fallback errs on the safe side (over-cap rather than under-cap) and is only used when the store lookup misses.

finding_status.notes: Both forms now call trigger('temperature') via useEffect keyed on selectedModel. AssistantSetupSection took trigger as a new UseFormTrigger prop; AssistantForm passes it through. VirtualAssistantForm already destructured trigger from useForm. Effect deps [selectedModel, trigger] — trigger is stable per RHF; effect fires only on model change.

getTemperatureMax now checks the store lookup first; on miss, falls back to looksLikeClaudeByName(modelValue) which returns true for any value containing 'claude' (case-insensitive) and maps to TEMPERATURE_MAX_CLAUDE. Two new unit tests cover the empty-store path for Claude and non-Claude names. Preserves the Claude cap on EditAssistant in-flight and getLLMModels-failure conditions.
Existing 'out of range' test now stubs GET /v1/llm_models with a single GPT-4o entry, decoupling the expected message from test ordering. Same mockAPI pattern used by the new integration tests.
